items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Yeah, well we took, and I took Yank and played. Yeah. I played with it for you, Yank.

ctx.x: Uh, Bunk used to talk about a fellow they called Mustache that ran that place. Some Italian.

Yeah, he did. Now, You take, uh, Louis played, Play, There's fifteen. Then, uh, You take Manuel and them had the coppery, Or had the economy hall. Manuel Perez. That's right. Manuel and them left here. Around in eighteen. Manuel and them left here. Then, Ori, Joe, Oliver. Baby, Dot and them. They took the economy hall. Eddie Vincent come here and got, uh, Joe Oliver. 된된된된된된된 Then Louis, you take, Piro had the boat. Piro and Peter and them had the boat. But still yet they had a contract for the halfway house back…
Was that for the boat then?
